liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (6 reviews, 1 other source): Reviewer especially loves the Dark Star; Dark Star runs a nice twenty minutes, played with conviction and fire [1][7][8][10][12][13][15]
- **Mason's Children** (5 reviews): The move from St. Stephen into Mason's Children is called one of a kind; Mason's Children is a rare song and treated as a real treat [7][8][10][14][17]

## The recordings

- **gd70-02-02.sbd.cotsman.17809.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 4 songs; 33 min; rated 4.64/5 by 14 [1]. Said about its sound: Sonic quality is excellent, notable in a year short on soundboards; The soundboard is excellent and resonant [10][13]
- **gd70-02-02.sbd.vernon.10374.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 4 songs; 32 min; rated 4/5 by 6 [3]
- **gd70-02-02.psbd.cousinit.18122.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 4 songs; 32 min; rated 3.43/5 by 7 [4]. Said about its sound: This partial soundboard sounds different from the other soundboards; reviewer finds the others better [15]
- **gd1970-02-02.sbd.miller.gans.121041.flac16**: soundboard; 4 songs; 33 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [2]

## Around the show

- Band had been arrested in New Orleans two days earlier, which the reviewer links to their inspired playing and to 'Truckin' [8]
- Reviewer notes the band played this old theater, recalling it from Deadbase [11]
- Earlier database entry lists 54 seconds of Uncle John's Band before Dark Star [6]
- Reviewer ranks this Dark Star second only to the one on 2/13/70 [17]
- Reviewer says this show foreshadows the 2/13/70 show [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd70-02-02.sbd.cotsman.17809.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by JCotsman; source: Soundboard (Partial Show) [1]. Also: Sound Forge was used for pitch correction and normalization; this is all that circulated as of Feb 2003 [1]
- **gd70-02-02.sbd.vernon.10374.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Raoul Duke and Matt Vernon; source: Soundboard (Partial Show) [3]. Also: Reviewer long had only the Dark Star on a multi-generation tape before getting this higher-quality copy; Lineage runs soundboard to MR to R to R to PCM to DAT to CDR, via Raoul Duke, seeded by Matt Vernon [3][18]
- **gd70-02-02.psbd.cousinit.18122.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Cousinit; source: Soundboard (Partial Show) [4]
- **gd1970-02-02.sbd.miller.gans.121041.flac16**: taped by David Gans; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Reel (7.5ips/Dolby B) [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [GRATEFUL DEAD 1970-02-02 Mon Groundhog Day Fox Theatre, St. Louis, MO](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1238471091702/grateful-dead-1970-02-02-mon-fox-theatre) [20]
